name: The Gilt Assembly
region: The Free City and its sky-docks
specialty: Trade, coin, and the writ to fly an airship
rivals: The Aether Guild, The Drowned Parliament
hook: No airship lifts without their stamp, and they will bankroll a bold expedition for first claim on whatever it hauls home. Take their coin and the sky-lanes open to you; balk at their cut and every port closes at once.

name: Pale Court of the Shroud
region: The Sunken Crypt and the barrow roads
population: A hidden few over many thralls
specialty: Blood-price, night travel, and old title
rivals: The Threshold Wardens, The Bone Clerks
hook: They trade in safe roads by night, old titles, and secrets the living have let rot. Each gift is paid in blood, and once you take one the Shroud may call on you, at the hour that suits it worst.

name: The Mycel Choir
hook: Gold leaves it cold, and so does your death; it wants only your sleep. Those who dream too long in its halls wake speaking for it.

name: Hammerdeep Concord
specialty: Steel, stonework, and forge-wrought magic weapons
rivals: The Red March, The Mycel Choir
hook: Theirs is the last forge that still wakes magic in steel. Carry them rare ore or a lost maker's-mark and they will arm you as they arm no outsider; break a sworn bargain and no dwarf hall will sell you a nail for nine generations.

name: The Thornwake
specialty: Wardings, archery, and a longer memory than yours
rivals: The Red March, The Mycel Choir
hook: They were old when the Free City was a ford, and they forget nothing. Return what was taken from the wood, or bring them one who despoiled it, and the grudge may thaw; raise an axe to their trees and it never will.

name: The Red March
specialty: Raiding, wolf-cavalry, and oaths of blood
hook: They despise a liar more than an enemy. Beat their champion in fair combat and the whole horde will sit and hear you out.

name: The Drowned Parliament
region: The coast and the deep sea
specialty: Storms, salvage, and a toll on every crossing
rivals: The Gilt Assembly, The Aether Guild
hook: It sets a price on each voyage, paid in cargo or in sailors. Pay it willingly and the sea stays kind for a season.

name: The Threshold Wardens
specialty: Wards against the dead and the chaotic; Turn Undead and Remove Curse
hook: They bar what should stay barred. They distrust every spellbook, and they are not always wrong to.

name: The Comet's Faithful
rivals: The Threshold Wardens, The Gilt Assembly
hook: They want the clock to run out. As the Decline advances they grow bolder, and one day the clerk you bribed is wearing their mark.

name: The Aether Guild
region: The sky-anchors and the high spires
specialty: Aether-engines and the secret of flight
rivals: The Gilt Assembly, The Drowned Parliament
hook: They sell flight and keep the why of it locked away. Recover lost engine-lore for them, or silence a leak, and doors open; cross a guildmaster and your engine coughs over the deepest water.

name: The Bone Clerks
region: The fallen heartland, where the doom has come
specialty: Necromancy and the muster of the dead
rivals: The Threshold Wardens, Pale Court of the Shroud
hook: They are the doom made flesh, drowning the fallen heartland in the risen dead while the tide climbs outward. Every barrow at their back is another regiment, and they mean to muster the whole kingdom, breathing or not.
